ops.rationale: Corrects the author names of wavelettensorecg2018 to Hong He, Yonghong Tan and Jianfeng Xing, as the Crossref and Semantic Scholar records and the publisher's BibTeX for doi 10.1016/j.knosys.2018.09.001 give them.
Reduces the doi field of hdbscan2013 to the bare DOI 10.1007/978-3-642-37456-2_14, which Crossref, OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar resolve; the escaped underscore broke the link.
